questions.question: When does David say he will direct his prayer to God?
What does God not delight in, according to Psalm 5?
options: Pride; the haughty cannot stand before him
Sacrifice; mere offerings cannot please him
Idols; false gods cannot deceive him
Wickedness; evil cannot dwell with him
questions.answer: Wickedness; evil cannot dwell with him
